note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Extra keys (note, followup, manual_prepare, manual_teardown) are for the recorder person; the kit ignores them. DATAVERSE_URL must point at the Sales trial environment (trial ends about 21 Dec 2026). Every python command opens its own MSAL interactive sign-in (the token cache is in memory): the owner signs in as labadmin when the browser asks, or exports the app-registration variables in the shell before recording (never in a file).
prepare: if (-not $env:DATAVERSE_URL) { throw 'Set $env:DATAVERSE_URL to the lab environment URL in this shell first (the owner does this; it is never written in a file).' }
Push-Location src; python -m salesctl doctor; Pop-Location
manual_prepare: Admin center, Sales trial, Users: give alex.demo the Salesperson role.
Sales Hub as alex.demo: create the lead 'Contoso Retail - analytics inquiry' (Jamie Rivera, Contoso Retail, jamie.rivera@contoso.example) and do not qualify it.
If the sample pipeline is clean, add three bad opportunities as alex.demo (past close date, no revenue, no close date).

screens.name: sales-lead-form
steps: Select the Sales trial environment, Apps, open Sales Hub (play)
Sales, Leads, open 'Contoso Retail - analytics inquiry'
Show Topic, Company, Jamie Rivera and the Lead to Opportunity Sales Process bar at the Qualify stage
mask: tenant name in the top bar
environment name and org URL (address bar and header)
user e-mail and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: salesctl-qualify
commands: python -m salesctl leads --email jamie.rivera@contoso.example | Tee-Object -Variable leadOut
screens.note: Second --apply is expected to be refused ('is not open'). Blur the GUIDs in the output; note the opportunity id for the 'sales-closed-won' screen (MGL_OPP_ID).

steps: Sales Hub: the lead is gone from open leads; the new opportunity, account and contact exist (small inset)
mask: tenant name in the top bar
environment name and org URL (address bar and header)
user e-mail and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: salesctl-pipeline
screens.note: hygiene exits 1 when it finds errors: that is the point. Blur company names that look real.

screens.name: sales-closed-won
prepare: if (-not $env:MGL_OPP_ID) { throw 'Set $env:MGL_OPP_ID (GUID of the opportunity created by the qualify step, shown in its read-back line) in this shell first (owner; never written in a file).' }

steps: Sales Hub: Opportunities, Closed Opportunities view: the opportunity is Won, actual revenue 48,000, forecast category Won
Open it, Related, Activities: the Opportunity Close activity
mask: tenant name in the top bar
environment name and org URL (address bar and header)
user e-mail and avatar in the account menu

manual_teardown: Delete the opportunity, account and contact created by qualify and the optional bad opportunities.
Remove alex.demo's Salesperson role if no later episode needs it.
needs: trial:Dynamics 365 Sales trial environment (ends about 21 Dec 2026)
